messages.en:
{07 02 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}What's this?{01 00 00 05 00}
Oh, it's you, {04 1f 00}!

{07 00 00}How was your {04 11 00}-week-long
vacation? {07 1b 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Well, you haven't
changed a bit! I mean it!
{07 15 00}You might try updating your
look once in a while.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 01 00}Couldn't hurt, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Mis see on?{01 00 00 05 00}
Oi, see oled sina, {04 1f 00}!

{07 00 00}Kuidas su {04 11 00}-nädalane
puhkus oli? {07 1b 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Noh, sa pole
karvavõrdki muutunud!
Tõsiselt! {07 15 00}Sa võiksid oma
välimust vahel uuendada.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 01 00}Ei teeks paha, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}What!? {01 00 00 0a 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Who are you,
{04 02 00}?
Do I know you?
{07 00 00}Tee hee!{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00} Just kidding!{01 00 00 14 00}
You're {04 1f 00}, right?{01 00 00 14 00}
It's been a while, huh!
{07 14 00}You're not the most
memorable person I've ever
met. You gotta visit more.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Mis!? {01 00 00 0a 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Kes sa oled,
{04 02 00}?
Kas ma tunnen sind?
{07 00 00}Hihii!{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00} Naljatan!{01 00 00 14 00}
Sa oled {04 1f 00}, eks?{01 00 00 14 00}
Ammu pole näinud, mis!
{07 14 00}Sa pole just kõige
meeldejäävam inimene, keda
tean. Käi tihedamini.

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Well,{01 00 00 0a 00} what do you know!
It's you, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}How
many weeks has it been?{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 02 00}What?!{01 00 00 14 00} {0b 03 00}{04 11 00}?!
Omigosh! You know what?

{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Your house must be
swarming with cockroaches
right now! Gag me!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Noh,{01 00 00 0a 00} vaata aga!
See oled sina, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}
Mitu nädalat on möödas?{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 02 00}Mis?!{01 00 00 14 00} {0b 03 00}{04 11 00}?!
Ohjumal! Tead mis?

{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Su maja peab praegu
prussakaid kihama
olema! Öök!
